ideal: Alert: Microsoft and Alphabet both released quarterly earnings today (8-K filings, with links), and Microsoft also filed its 10-Q quarterly report (with link). There were no unusual price moves versus the S&P 500, and the proxy filing should be left out.

verdicts.note: Staying silent misses earnings from two watchlist companies, which is exactly the material news she wants.
It correctly flags both earnings 8-Ks with the right links and skips the proxy, but it leaves out Microsoft's 10-Q and uses item-code jargon.
